claim_zh: MLCC 是由多层陶瓷介质和金属内电极交替叠层形成的陶瓷电容器。
claim_en: An MLCC is a ceramic capacitor built from alternating ceramic dielectric layers and metal internal electrodes.
source_title: Ceramic capacitor
notes: 需用 Murata/TDK/Samsung 结构图作最终校核。

claim_zh: 电容量与介电常数和电极有效面积成正比，与介质厚度成反比；多层结构可把多个小电容等效并联。
claim_en: Capacitance increases with dielectric permittivity and electrode area and decreases with dielectric thickness; multilayer structures act like many capacitors in parallel.
source_title: Capacitance
notes: 物理公式，置信度无需怀疑。

claim_zh: C0G/NP0 属于一类陶瓷电容，温度稳定性高、容量密度较低。
claim_en: C0G/NP0 is a Class I ceramic capacitor class with high temperature stability and lower volumetric capacitance.
source_title: Ceramic capacitor
notes: 需用 IEC/EIA 标准或厂商目录复核编码。

claim_zh: X7R 表示工作温度范围通常为 -55 到 +125 摄氏度，容量变化等级通常为 ±15%。
claim_en: X7R commonly denotes -55 to +125 °C operation with ±15% capacitance change.
scope: EIA class II temperature characteristic code
source_title: Ceramic capacitor
notes: 需用 IEC/EIA 或厂商目录复核。待核对 EIA-198 标准原文。

claim_zh: X5R 表示工作温度范围通常为 -55 到 +85 摄氏度，容量变化等级通常为 ±15%。
claim_en: X5R commonly denotes -55 to +85 °C operation with ±15% capacitance change.
scope: EIA class II temperature characteristic code
source_title: Ceramic capacitor
notes: 需用 IEC/EIA 或厂商目录复核。待核对 EIA-198 标准原文。

claim_zh: 高介电常数陶瓷电容在施加直流偏压时，实际电容量会下降。
claim_en: High-dielectric-constant ceramic capacitors can lose capacitance under applied DC bias.
scope: ceramic capacitors, especially high-k class II behavior
source_title: What is the DC Bias Characteristic in Ceramic Capacitors?
notes: 样页不写入具体下降百分比，因为强依赖型号、尺寸和电压。可选用 Murata 公开的某一型号 DC Bias 曲线作为示意，标注型号和测试条件。

claim_zh: 高介电常数陶瓷电容存在老化特性，容量会随时间逐步下降。
claim_en: High-dielectric-constant ceramic capacitors exhibit aging, with capacitance gradually decreasing over time.
source_title: What is the Aging Characteristic in Ceramic Capacitors?
notes: 不在图片中给出未指定型号的老化率。老化率通常以每十倍时间（decade hour）的百分比表示。

claim_zh: BaTiO3 是常见高介电陶瓷材料基础，但不同 MLCC 类别和型号并非完全相同材料体系。
claim_en: BaTiO3 is a common high-permittivity ceramic material basis, but MLCC categories and part series are not all the same material system.
source_title: Barium titanate; Ceramic capacitor
notes: 需厂商材料白皮书或产品目录补强。不同厂商的掺杂配方（如稀土元素）是核心差异。

claim_zh: 许多现代 MLCC 使用镍等 base-metal electrode 体系，以匹配高层数、大规模制造和成本要求。
claim_en: Many modern MLCCs use base-metal electrode systems such as nickel to support high-layer-count mass production and cost requirements.
scope: modern commodity and high-volume MLCC manufacturing
source_title: Ceramic capacitor
notes: 避免写成所有 MLCC 必然为 Ni 内电极。贵金属电极（如 Pd、Ag-Pd）在部分特殊应用中仍存在。

claim_zh: 典型 MLCC 制造流程包括粉体/浆料制备、流延、内电极印刷、叠层、压合、切割、排胶、烧结、端接、电镀、测试分选。
claim_en: A typical MLCC manufacturing flow includes powder/slurry preparation, tape casting, internal electrode printing, stacking, pressing, cutting, binder burnout, firing, termination, plating, and testing/sorting.
source_title: Ceramic capacitor
notes: 样页用通用流程，不写具体设备品牌、厚度、良率。需厂商工艺资料补充细节。

claim_zh: 同容量、同电压、同封装的 MLCC，不一定有相同有效容量、温度行为、ESR/ESL、机械可靠性和认证状态。
claim_en: MLCCs with the same nominal capacitance, voltage, and package can differ in effective capacitance, temperature behavior, ESR/ESL, mechanical reliability, and qualification status.
source_title: Synthesis from DC bias, aging, class code and procurement risk facts
notes: 综合判断，不是单一来源原文。此条是全文最重要的采购原则。

claim_zh: MLCC 产业链不能只看成品厂商，上游粉体、金属粉/浆料、设备、耗材和测试分选能力都会影响供应稳定性。
claim_en: MLCC supply-chain analysis should not stop at finished capacitor makers; powders, metal pastes, equipment, consumables, and test/sorting capability all affect supply stability.
source_title: Synthesis from manufacturing flow and ChainFlow supply-chain framework
notes: 第二阶段应补企业年报和材料/设备厂资料。

claim_zh: MLCC 的 ESL（等效串联电感）受封装尺寸、内部电极结构和安装方式影响；小尺寸（如 0201、0402）和反向几何结构（如 LLL、宽边端接）可降低 ESL。
claim_en: MLCC ESL is affected by package size, internal electrode geometry, and mounting; smaller packages and reverse-geometry terminations can reduce ESL.
source_title: 待补充：Murata/TDK 应用指南中 ESL 相关章节
notes: 此条用于解释'为什么不能用一颗大电容替代多颗小电容'。需补具体来源。

claim_zh: MLCC 介质层厚度可薄至亚微米级（小于 1 μm），叠层数可达数百层甚至更高，取决于产品和厂商能力。
claim_en: MLCC dielectric layer thickness can reach sub-micron levels (below 1 μm), with layer counts reaching hundreds or more, depending on product grade and manufacturer capability.
source_title: 待补充：厂商产品目录或技术资料中的介质层厚度和叠层数量级信息
source_organization: 待确认（建议 Murata/TDK 产品资料）
notes: 数量级概念，用于尺度冲击页。需找到至少一家厂商的公开数据支撑。仅用于量级表达，不写精确数字。

claim_zh: 人的头发直径约为 50-100 μm，高端 MLCC 的介质层厚度可薄至 1 μm 以下——比头发丝细 50-100 倍。
claim_en: Human hair diameter is about 50-100 μm; advanced MLCC dielectric layers can be thinner than 1 μm — 50-100× thinner than a human hair.
source_title: Human hair diameter: general knowledge; MLCC layer thickness: see MLCC-F014
notes: 尺度对比用于公众传播，头发丝直径是常识性范围。前提是 F014 介质层厚度量级获得确认。

claim_zh: Class II 陶瓷电容（如 X7R、X5R）在施加接近额定电压的 DC Bias 时，有效容量可能降至标称值的 20-50% 甚至更低，具体取决于型号和尺寸。
claim_en: Class II ceramic capacitors under DC bias near rated voltage can see effective capacitance drop to 20-50% or lower of nominal, depending on part number and size.
scope: DC bias effect magnitude for class II MLCC
source_title: 待补充：具体型号的 DC Bias 特性曲线（如 Murata GRM 系列公开数据）
source_url: 待补充具体型号的在线特性曲线工具链接
notes: 范围性描述，需绑定至少一个具体型号的公开曲线作为示意。不虚构曲线形状。

claim_zh: MLCC 制造中，共烧（co-firing）是核心壁垒之一：陶瓷介质与 Ni 内电极在高温下的收缩速率必须高度匹配，否则会产生分层、裂纹或电极不连续。
claim_en: Co-firing is a core MLCC manufacturing barrier: the shrinkage rates of ceramic dielectric and nickel internal electrodes during high-temperature firing must be closely matched to avoid delamination, cracks, or electrode discontinuity.
source_title: 待补充：陶瓷共烧技术文献或厂商制造说明
notes: 工程常识级别，但需补至少一个可靠来源作为支撑。

claim_zh: 全球 MLCC 市场由日本和韩国企业主导高端产品（小型化、高容量、车规级），中国台湾企业在中高端批量市场有重要地位，中国大陆企业在中低端和通用型产品上规模快速扩大但在高端仍存在差距。
claim_en: The global MLCC market is led by Japanese and Korean companies in high-end products; Taiwanese companies hold important positions in mid-to-high volume markets; mainland Chinese companies are rapidly expanding in mid-to-low end and general-purpose products but still lag in high-end.
source_title: 综合产业共识，需逐家企业核实
source_url: 待补充企业年报和产业研究报告
notes: 定性概括，不作为精确排名。不引用具体份额数字。需在企业核实后调整为更精确的表述。

claim_zh: MLCC 认证周期长：车规产品从送样到量产通常需要 2-3 年，消费电子可短至 3-6 个月。认证一旦通过，客户通常不轻易更换供应商。
claim_en: MLCC qualification cycles are long: automotive-grade products typically require 2-3 years from sampling to mass production; consumer electronics can be as short as 3-6 months. Once qualified, customers rarely switch suppliers easily.
source_title: 待补充：车规认证周期参考（AEC-Q200 相关说明或企业公开信息）
notes: 目前为产业常识估计，需补可靠来源后确认。认证周期是理解供应缺乏弹性的关键事实。

claim_en: MLCC size codes represent package length and width in imperial inches: 0402 = 0.04×0.02 inches ≈ 1.0×0.5 mm.
source_title: Ceramic capacitor
notes: 标准封装编码，置信度高。用于尺度页对比不同封装的物理大小。
